title.narrative: Strengthening the Effectiveness of the Social Safety Net Results-Based Financing Specific Investment Loan

description.narrative: The development objective of the Strengthen the Effectiveness of the Social Safety Net Project is to improve the efficiency and equity of Moldova's social safety net through a fiscally sustainable expansion and strengthening of the Ajutor social program. The project will consist of two components. The first component will co-finance the scaling up of two targeted programs (the Ajutor social program and targeted heating allowances), while supporting the consolidation and downsizing of other benefit programs. It will link disbursements to the achievement of specific results measured by - disbursement-linked indicators. The second component will finance investments to strengthen the basic architecture of the social assistance system, with a focus on the Ajutor social program.

The development objective of the proposed project is to improve the efficiency and equity of Moldova's safety net through a fiscally sustainable expansion and strengthening of the Ajutor Social Program.

However, because of lack of political commitment to continue consolidation, the indicator slipped back in the following years.

comment.narrative: Surpassed (processing time reduced). The number of days varies in different years from 8 days to 14 days because the turn-around time for processing Ajutor Social is highly dependent on number of registered applications at the community level and workload at the SAD level were applications are verified before a decision is taken.

title.narrative: Share of Moldova citizens who are aware of Ajutor Social Program

comment.narrative: Achieved. Per 2017 HBS special section/question. Wording revised in the 2015 restructuring. This indicator is a measure of transparency and as such is part of the measurement of Results Area 3, which looks at governance and transparency in par with administrative efficiency.

title.narrative: Project Development Indicator 2. Targeting Accuracy:The share of Ajutor Social transfers that reach the poorest population quintiler emains above 65%

comment.narrative: Achieved. Main indicator: Per 2016 HBS data the targeting accuracy reached 77.3%. Achieved. Final indicator calculated in 2017 based on 2016 HBS data. During the project years the indicator value was never been below the established limit. Sub-indicator: The sub-indicator was revised as part of restructuring (target reduced from 60,000 to 55,000 as a result of new census data). This did not influence the main indicator.
